script.en: Home style food, made by family.

parrafo.es: Chandlers Place es una cocina familiar en el corazon de Coral Gables: take out, delivery y catering para toda ocasion, desde un almuerzo rapido hasta la mesa completa de tu proximo evento.
parrafo.en: Chandlers Place is a family run kitchen in the heart of Coral Gables: take out, delivery and catering for any occasion, from a quick lunch to the full spread for your next event.

hero.imagen_alt: Shaded outdoor patio seating at Chandlers Place in Coral Gables

parrafo_1.es: Chandlers Place lleva mas de 14 anos en Alhambra Circle, en pleno Coral Gables. La cocina la llevan un matrimonio que recibe a cada cliente como familia, con comida simple y casera hecha el mismo dia.
parrafo_1.en: Chandlers Place has been on Alhambra Circle in the heart of Coral Gables for over 14 years. The kitchen is run by a husband and wife who welcome every customer like family, with simple, homemade food made fresh the same day.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten lo mismo en Google: la calidez de los duenos y lo bien que saben los platos de siempre, desde las brochetas hasta la reposteria para ocasiones especiales.
parrafo_2.en: Clients mention the same thing on Google: the warmth of the owners and how good the everyday dishes taste, from the skewers to the desserts made for special occasions.

texto.es: Cuentanos que necesitas al +1 305-444-1121: un almuerzo rapido o el catering completo de tu evento.
texto.en: Tell us what you need at +1 305-444-1121: a quick lunch or the full catering spread for your event.

texto.es: Te confirmamos el menu disponible ese dia y el precio segun tu pedido.
texto.en: We confirm the menu available that day and the price based on your order.

texto.es: Pasas por 166 Alhambra Cir o coordinamos delivery, Lunes a Viernes de 7am a 4pm.
texto.en: Stop by 166 Alhambra Cir or we arrange delivery, Monday to Friday 7am to 4pm.

texto.es: Comida casera, hecha el mismo dia, igual que la describen nuestros clientes en Google.
texto.en: Home style food, made the same day, just like our customers describe on Google.

nota.es: Cada pedido se cotiza segun el menu del dia y la cantidad. Llama y te damos el detalle antes de confirmar nada.
nota.en: Every order is quoted based on the day's menu and the quantity. Call and we will walk you through it before anything is confirmed.

texto.es: Brochetas de pollo estilo griego con tomate, feta y aceitunas, y platos caseros que cambian segun el dia.
texto.en: Greek-style chicken skewers with tomato, feta and olives, plus homemade daily plates that change through the week.

texto.es: Platon de camarones con salsa coctel y limon, listo para llevar a tu mesa o a tu evento.
texto.en: Shrimp cocktail platter with sauce and lemon, ready to bring to your table or your event.

texto.es: Pasteles como nuestro corazon de chocolate y fresas, y canastas de regalo armadas para fechas especiales.
texto.en: Cakes like our chocolate and strawberry heart, and gift baskets put together for special dates.

texto.es: Armamos el menu de tu evento con nuestros platos de siempre, en la cantidad que necesites.
texto.en: We build your event's menu from our everyday dishes, in whatever quantity you need.

pie.es: No ves lo que buscas? Llamanos igual, el menu cambia segun el dia.
pie.en: Do not see what you are looking for? Call us anyway, the menu changes by the day.

items.quote: I had the pan con bistec with garbanzos, and it was delicious! The owners are all amazing and welcomed me like family. Their sweets are wonderful, too. I had such a great experience at Chandler Place in Coral Gables and will definitely be back!

I discovered this place travelling for work and love it. It's run by a husband and wife who are so sweet and friendly. The food is simple but delicious. They've been in business for 14 years so make sure you stop by to keep this great family run business going.

texto.es: Lunes a Viernes, 7am a 4pm. Cerrado Sabado y Domingo.
texto.en: Monday to Friday, 7am to 4pm. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
